questions.question: What is the value of 2² + 6² + 10² + 14² - 1² - 5² - 9² - 13²?
The sum of three consecutive natural numbers is always divisible by _______.
questions.solution:
Let three consecutive number be x, (x + 1), (x + 2)

Sum = x + x+ 1 + x + 2 = 3x + 3 = 3(x + 1)

∴ Sum of three consecutive natural number will be always divisible by 3

questions.question: A boy added all natural numbers from 1 to 20, however he missed one number due to which the sum becomes 190. What is the number which the boy missed?
questions.solution:
Sum of natural numbers 1 to 20 = 20 / 2[(2 ⨯ 1 + (20 - 1)1]

10 ⨯ 21 = 210

∴ Missing natural number = 210 - 190 = 20

questions.question: If 142N is divisible by 12, then what is the value of N?
questions.solution:
For 142N to be divisible by 12 it must be divisible by 3 and 4 both

For divisible by 4 last 2 digits divisible by 4

For that N = 0, 4, 8

For divisible by 3 Sum of number will be divisible by 3

For that N = 2, 5, 8

∴ For both N = 8

questions.question: 3/4 part of a tank is filled with oil. After taking out 60 litres of oil the tank is 2/3 part full. What is the capacity (in litres) of the tank?
questions.solution:
Let capacity of tank be x

According to Question,

⇒ 3x / 4 - 60 = 2x / 3

⇒ 3x / 4 - 2x / 3 = 60

⇒ x / 12 = 60

⇒ x = 720

∴ Capacity of tank = 720 litres

questions.question: Raman is three times as efficient as Manan. Raman can complete a work in 60 days less than Manan. In how many days the work would be complete if both of them work together?
questions.solution:
Let the work done by Raman be x

Then work done by Manan will be 3x

Let the time taken by Manan be a days

Then Raman will complete the work in a - 60 days

So According to Work theorem

M1W2 = M2W1

⇒ x ⨯ a = 3x ⨯ (a - 60)

⇒ ax = 3xa - 180x

⇒ ax( 1 - 3) = -180x

⇒ a = 90

Time taken by Manan = 90 days

Time taken by Raman = 90 - 60 = 30 days

Time taken by both to complete the work = (1 / 90) + (1 / 30)

Time taken by both to complete the work = (1 + 3) / 90

Time taken by both to complete the work = 4 / 90

Time taken by both to complete the work = 2 / 45

∴ Time taken by both to complete the work = 22.5 days

questions.question: After giving a discount of 44% a cycle is sold for Rs 17920. What is the marked price (in Rs.) of the cycle?
The marked price of an article is 80% more than its cost price. What should be the discount (in %) offered by the shopkeeper so that he earns a profit of 44%?
questions.solution:
Let CP be Rs. 100

MP = 80% more than CP = 180

Now, profit = 44% of CP = Rs.44

SP = CP + Profit = Rs. (100 + 44) = Rs. 144

D = MP - SP = 180 - 144 = Rs. 36

∴ Discount % = 36 / 180 ⨯ 100 = 20%

Let the distance be s

So time taken by A = s / 2x

Time taken by B = s / 3x

Time taken by C = s / 6x

Ratio of time taken = (s / 2x) : (s / 3x) : (s / 6x)

Multiplying by 6 we get

∴ Ratio of time taken = 3 : 2 : 1

questions.question: If x - y : y - z : z - k = 2 : 3 : 5, then what is the value of z : (x + k)?
questions.solution:
x - y : y - z : z - k = 2 : 3 : 5

⇒ (x - y)/(y - z) = 2/3

⇒ 3x - 3y = 2y - 2z

⇒ 3x = 5y - 2z

∴ x = (5y - 2z)/3 ......1

⇒ (y - z)/(z - k) = 3/5

⇒ 5y - 5z = 3z - 3k

⇒ 3k = 8z - 5y

∴k = (8z - 5y)/3 ......2

Now we add equation 1 and 2

x + k = (5y - 2z)/3 + (8z - 5y)/3 = 2

∴ z : (x + k) = 1 : 2

questions.question: The average of 19 results is 111. If the average of first 10 results is 82 and that of the last 10 results is 129, then what will be the 10 result?
questions.solution:
**Short trick∶**

Required average = 82 × 10 + 129 × 10 - 19 × 111 = 1

**Detailed solution∶**

Average of 19 results = 111

Sum of 19 results = 111 ⨯19 = 2109

Average of first 10 results = 82

Sum of first 10 results = 820

Average of last 10 results = 129

Sum of last 10 results = 1290

Sum of first 10 results and last 10 results = 820 + 1290 = 2110

∴ 10 results = 2110 - 2109 = 1

questions.question: Eleven friends spent Rs 19 each on a tour and the twelfth friend spent Rs 11 less than the average expenditure of all twelve of them. What is the total money (in Rs) spent by them?
questions.solution:
Average expenditure of 11 students = 19 × 11 = Rs. 209

Let money spent by the twelfth friend be Rs.x

Total money spent by all the 12 friend = 209 + x

Average money spent by 12 friend = (209 + x) / 12

Given, x = [(209 + x)/12] - 11

⇒ 12x = 209 + x - 132

⇒ 11x = 77

∴ x = 7

Total expense = 209 + 7 = Rs. 216

questions.question: A is 16.66% less than B. If value of A is 500, then what is the value of B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A is 16.66% less than B

**Calculation:**

We know that 16.66% is 1/6

ATQ,

⇒ A is 1/6 less than B

⇒ A = (6 - 1) over 6 B

⇒ A = (5/6) B

Now, Putting the value of A as 500,

⇒ 500 = 5/6 B

⇒ B = 600

**∴ The value of B is 600**.

**Calculation:**

2a - 2/a + 4 = 0

2a - 2/ a = -4

a - 1 / a = -2

Cubing on both sides

a³ - 1/a³ - 3a × 1/a (a - 1/a) = -8

a³ - 1/a³ - 3 × -2 = -8

a³ - 1/a³ = -8 -6 = -14

∴ a³ - 1/a³ + 2 = -14 + 2 = -12
